//: SPA fallback: this is a client-routed React Router app, so any path that isn't a real file must serve index.html and let the router resolve it. Without this, deep links 404 — including /auth/reset (password-reset emails), /auth/callback (OAuth + email verification) and every in-app route on refresh. Vercel matches the filesystem before rewrites, so hashed assets in /assets still serve normally.
